## Findings
- claim-1: The supplied record contains no fifteen-case table with the required conditions, column orders, selected rows, or matrices; hence the requested literal products cannot be reconstructed without invention.
## Strategy
The required fifteen-case table is absent. No matrices or cases are inferred from the five available degree-\(d+3\) cases.

## Gaps
The certificate is not established: exact conditions, ordered columns, selected rows, \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), \(\mathcal C\), and \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\) for ten or more unidentified cases are missing.
